WHITE HOUSE WARNS U.S. INFLATION NEEDS MORE WORK White House economic adviser Kevin Hassett says inflation is showing renewed pressure after several months of improvement. September CPI rose 0.6% month-over-month, while core inflation increased 0.3%. Hassett warned the acceleration could be temporary or signal a break from the disinflation trend.

HEDGE FUNDS DUMP TECH STOCKS AT FASTEST PACE IN A DECADE Goldman Sachs reports that hedge funds cut technology exposure at the fastest pace since at least 2016 during the five sessions ending October 15. The Nasdaq 100 plunged 5.5% last week, while semiconductor stocks suffered the largest dollar selling. Despite the selloff, tech still represents 23.5% of hedge fund portfolios, near historically elevated levels.

OPENAI SEEKS $1.4 TRILLION VALUATION AHEAD OF ANTHROPIC IPO OpenAI is reportedly racing to raise $30 billion at a valuation exceeding $1.4 trillion before Anthropic’s expected November IPO. SoftBank and MGX are among potential investors. OpenAI reportedly claims $50 billion in annualized revenue, targeting $70 billion by year-end.
